sn1.37:1.5: “The Buddha is staying in the land of the Sakyans, in the Great Wood near Kapilavatthu, together with a large Saṅgha of five hundred mendicants, all of whom are perfected ones;
sn1.37:1.6: and most of the deities from ten solar systems have gathered to see the Buddha and the Saṅgha of mendicants.
